Note: the implementer's pace A/B base (8e58556fa) already had the carrot code (laneCarrot is in 8e58556fa:minions.ts), so that A/B only tested the march watch. The A/B below is the real before/after.
method.independent_measure: _harness/_tmp_vfy_laneline_meas.ts. Free = no ATTACK order, not chasing, not stepping out, no attackable enemy in aggro. Clear = more than 3 m from any structure rim and from any live body except Wicks of its own team, more than 16 m of arc from its spawn end and more than 6 m from the far end. off = d - slot. Fewer exclusions than the lane's probe: no settling window, no 'own held Wick' or 'other wave pressed' exclusion, no forced-movement exclusion. --strict 1 also requires the Wick to have walked at least 0.8x its speed over the last 0.5 s, so a Wick queued behind its wave does not count.
method.live: _harness/_tmp_vfy_laneline_live.mjs. Own headless Chrome with two frozen vite servers of its own (:5391 base, :5392 new), render bench with every seat played, fog off. Each frame pumped at 1/30 s from 1:30 to 8:00 (11728 frames). Records all Wicks in 4 boxes: top road from base to the 2nd tower for team 0 (30,27) and team 1 (140,27), and the bottom road for both teams (30,83) and (140,83). Seeds 3 and 11, both arms.
